title: Files & Storage says 'Last backup: Never' while Settings > Advanced > Backup & Restore says 'Last Full Backup: Aug 2, 2026 10:30' — same app, same second, same fact
evidence_file_line: packages/skotiq_app/lib/screens/settings/widgets/auto_save_settings.dart:169 (page now watches autoSaveLifecycleProvider — the only provider that loads the persisted autosave.* keys and calls start(config, lastBackup)) and :193 (status = ref.watch(autoSaveStatusProvider).valueOrNull ?? service.status), backed by packages/skotiq_core/lib/src/services/auto_save_service.dart:762-780 (autoSaveStatusProvider backfills lastBackup from autosave.last_backup_at — the same key Backup & Restore reads).
summary: The defect is closed in the tree today by a wave that recorded it under a different title. The verifier's location_wrong is exactly right about the mechanism and exactly right about the fix site: the page used to render ref.watch(autoSaveServiceProvider) — the un-started instance the last backendProvider swap rebuilt — and drove the Status card from a StreamSubscription on that instance's statusStream, so a hydrated timestamp never reached it. Today the page renders the hydrated service from autoSaveLifecycleProvider (auto_save_settings.dart:169) and takes the Status card's timestamp from autoSaveStatusProvider (auto_save_settings.dart:193), which backfills from the persisted autosave.last_backup_at (auto_save_service.dart:762-780). That is the SAME provider Settings > Advanced > Backup & Restore reads (backup_screen.dart:432 -> :539), so the two surfaces are now fed by one source and cannot disagree. Both call sites checked; a repo-wide sweep for lastBackup/last_backup across Dart, Rust, and the web dashboard finds no third surface that renders a last-backup time. 'Never' is now reachable only when autosave.last_backup_at is genuinely absent. The location the finding itself named (auto_save_service.dart:149-166) is an earlier partial fix that publishes the hydrated status on the stream; it is still present and still correct, but it is not what closes this — consistent with location_wrong.
test: packages/skotiq_app/test/screens/settings/auto_save_settings_hydration_test.dart — 5 cases, all passing (flutter test, skotiq_app). It covers both halves of the repro and, deliberately, disables one truthful source at a time: 'truthful with only the lifecycle-hydration path' parks autoSaveStatusProvider in AsyncLoading, and 'truthful with only the persisted-key backfill' overrides autoSaveLifecycleProvider with an un-started orphan service (the post-backend-swap instance) so only the autosave.last_backup_at backfill remains. Each asserts the rendered card reads '2h ago' and not 'Never'.
revert_check: Severed the production wiring in packages/skotiq_app/lib/screens/settings/widgets/auto_save_settings.dart: replaced lines 169-180 (the ref.watch(autoSaveLifecycleProvider).when(...) block) with `return _buildConfigured(context, ref.watch(autoSaveServiceProvider));` and lines 192-193 with `final status = service.status;` — i.e. restored the pre-fix source of truth. Result: ALL 5 tests in auto_save_settings_hydration_test.dart failed, the three status cases with `Actual: Found 0 widgets with text "2h ago"` (the card was back to 'Never'/'Pending'), the two config cases on the compiled-in defaults. Restored from a byte-copy (cmp reports IDENTICAL) and re-ran: 5/5 pass.
caveats: The fix lives in the working tree, not in a commit — `git status` shows auto_save_settings.dart as modified against c66c60f71. It ships only if that working tree is committed. Nothing was changed by this task.
